description: Synchronously poll exactly ONE registered PULLING source by id, with a single raising failure channel. Targeted counterpart to trigger_poll (which polls ALL sources and silently skips a contended or failing one). Acquires the source's polling lease, drives one discover -> read -> persist pass, finalizes its route batch COMPLETED, and returns {sources_polled, sessions_seen, events_persisted, batches_failed} with sources_polled=1 and batches_failed=0 on success. RAISES LedgerPollError on a missing / deleted / disabled source, a non-PULLING source, lease contention, or any source-pass failure -- so callers (the ChatGPT-export ingest kickoff A1, the duplicate-source repair completeness step) get a hard 'one source polled, zero failed' guarantee instead of re-interpreting a silent zero.
embedding_description: Synchronously poll ONE session-ledger source by source_id; single raising failure channel (LedgerPollError) unlike trigger_poll's all-sources silent-skip. Acquires the polling lease, drives one pulling pass, completes the route batch, returns ImporterReport counts (sources_polled=1, sessions_seen, events_persisted, batches_failed=0) or raises on missing/disabled/non-pulling/lease-contention/pass-failure. Used by the ChatGPT export ingest kickoff and the duplicate-source repair completeness step.
